DRC-01C.title: Difference between input credit claimed and credit available
DRC-01C.meaning: The GST system says you claimed more input credit in your GSTR-3B than your suppliers reported for you in GSTR-2B.
DRC-01C.what_to_do: Either pay back the extra credit with interest, or explain the difference with proof.
papers: Messages or emails to suppliers who have not reported

ASMT-10.title: Scrutiny notice: figures in your returns do not match
ASMT-10.meaning: A tax officer compared your returns with other data, such as e-way bills, and found a difference that needs an explanation.
ASMT-10.what_to_do: Reply with an explanation, or pay the difference if the officer is right.
papers: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B for the period
E-way bills generated in the period
ASMT-10.source: CGST Act s.61 and Rule 99 (verify current)
